title: April 2026 High-Yield Exam Rapid Recall & Summary
summary: Consolidated high-yield sweep of key figures, policy dates, and macro indicators from April 2026.

blocks.content: High-speed sweep of top facts for April 2026:

items: **Paytm Payments Bank**: License cancelled under Sec 22(4) BR Act w.e.f. April 24, 2026.
**LIC 1:1 Bonus**: Capitalising ₹6,325 Cr, doubling paid-up capital to ₹12,650 Cr.
**2FA & E-Mandate**: Mandatory 2FA for digital payments; e-mandates up to ₹15,000 without AFA.
**Income Tax Rules 2026**: Tax Year replaces Previous/Assessment Year (Kar Saathi AI launched).
**Census 2027 Phase I**: House listing launched April 1, 2026 (1st digital & caste count).
**Google Cloud AI Hub**: $15 Billion investment in Visakhapatnam (1 GW capacity).
**INS Aridaman**: 3rd Arihant-class SSBN inducted into Indian Navy.
